- Security fixes
  - Transmitting: while the radio transmits, nothing can change its frequency, rate, gains or amplifier any more, so a transmission stays on the frequency it was checked for
  - Push to talk: the transmission now stops whatever ends the press (leaving the page, the app going to the background), and after 3 minutes at most
  - Radio reception: a malformed or hostile frame can no longer crash the app, the decoder drops it and goes on
  - DNS: only the server that was asked can answer, and only to the question that was sent
  - Links read from NFC tags and beacons: only web and map links are opened, anything else is copied
  - CSV exports: a cell that starts like a spreadsheet formula (=, +, -, @) is saved as text, so text received from the air cannot run in Excel or LibreOffice
  - Updates: a download far bigger than a release is stopped
  - Microphone: it is released by the thread that reads it
